module: D09-13 Industry Structure／Porter Five Forces產業結構與波特五力
purpose: Freeze effective-dated issuer product/application scope and compatible revenue denominators while refusing to manufacture unavailable ABF/AI exposure numerators.

productScope.source: issuer official company profile and dated investor briefings

issuers.rule: Product/application presence is verified; exposure magnitude is not.

productScope.source: issuer official product pages and chairman message
productScope.currentStrategyEvidence: Issuer states strategic focus on high-end FCBGA/SiP and significant growth in AI advanced-packaging substrate revenue contribution, without a compatible percentage denominator.

issuers.rule: Qualitative growth contribution cannot be converted to a numeric share.

evidence: 2025 Taiwan PCB manufacturing output reached NT$915.2bn.
2025 Q3 substrates grew 14.2% YoY while flexible/rigid-flex declined.
AI/server applications drove ABF, high-layer-count and HDI demand.
ABF substrate material and substrate manufacturing are separate economic markets.
externalIndustryContext.useRule: Industry product/application growth is context only and cannot fill issuer revenue numerators.

denominatorFirewall: issuer total revenue denominator + product presence does not identify product revenue share
TPCA product growth cannot be multiplied into issuer exposure percentage
ABF material market share cannot be mapped to ABF substrate manufacturer share
company roadmap/certification is not realized revenue
qualitative 'significant growth' does not supply a numeric denominator

pitSemantics.unit: issuer × product/application evidence vintage × compatible accounting denominator
pitSemantics.historicalRule: Do not backfill current product mix into prior years.

reasonNoL4: Exposure semantics improved, but product/application revenue numerators remain missing and no prospective/OOS structure-to-outcome test exists.
exactNext: BR-059 capture issuer-native product/application revenue percentages only if future audited/IR disclosures provide compatible numerators.
Keep ABF/AI exposure magnitude UNKNOWN until such denominator exists.
Use BR-057 as a denominator firewall for all future PCB/ABF issuer comparisons.
